contract.provides: For a nonempty Boolean polytope P subset[0,1]^n, supplied integer1<=k<=n bounding support of every actual edge, rational x in P and rational A with column Euclidean norms<=1, an exact strong linear-optimization oracle returns an exactly optimizing Boolean vertex for every rational objective. The source proposes deterministic polynomial-bit construction of r<=dim F(x)+1<=n+1 Boolean vertices in the minimal ORIGINAL face F(x), with rational probabilities, exact mean x and discrepancy strictly<B(k)=16 floor(sqrt(64k))^2+136k+1<=1161k on every supported atom. Every oracle call/objective bit length and geometric reduction is charged. For each rational cost c a favorable good vertex satisfies c^T v<=c^T x; this is not cost-favorability of every atom for every c. Arbitrary matroid bases need only an independence oracle and have B(2)=2209. Singleton/integral x is immediate. The sharper N749 existence bound54k (matroid108) is not constructed here.
